title: USS Finch cigar-shaped object shot down near Johnston Island

tellings.quote: guys and they're all talking about the bogey that was seemed to be shot out of the sky

plain: A writer on UFO history, Richard Dolan, passes on an account from a man named David Noble White Horse about the US Navy ship USS Finch near Johnston Island, a small Pacific atoll, in 1962, around the time of a nuclear test there. According to the account, the sailors were all talking about a cigar-shaped bogey, meaning an unknown object, that seemed to have been shot out of the sky. If true, it would mean the military brought down an unknown craft.
